audit_summary.summary: Four naming findings under GTM-NAME-001; one conservative tag rename in draft JSON; three suggestions held for manual review.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: vague tag name "tag 1"
findings.description: GTM-NAME-001 / NAME-TAG-001: existing name lacks the prescribed purpose and type context. Candidate: "GA4 - Event - lead_submit". Policy: allowed_candidate.

evidence.observation: tagId=101; type=gaawe; eventName=lead_submit; measurementId={{id}}; firingTriggerId=201; parentFolderId=401.
GA4 event tag name is supported by tag type and eventName.

recommended_actions: Rename tag 101 to GA4 - Event - lead_submit (included in draft).

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: vague trigger name "all"
findings.description: GTM-NAME-001 / NAME-TRIGGER-001: existing name lacks the prescribed purpose and type context. Candidate: "PV - All Pages". Policy: manual_review_only.

evidence.observation: triggerId=201; type=PAGEVIEW; no explicit filter or condition exported.
All Pages scope is inferred, not proven by a live test.

recommended_actions: Confirm pageview scope before considering PV - All Pages; do not alter trigger conditions.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: vague variable name "id"
findings.description: GTM-NAME-001 / NAME-VARIABLE-001: existing name lacks the prescribed purpose and type context. Candidate: "CONST - GA4 Measurement ID". Policy: manual_review_only.

evidence.observation: variableId=301; type=c; constant value=G-TEST501; tag 101 references {{id}} in measurementId.
Constant appears to be a measurement ID; renaming without updating the variable token could break references.

recommended_actions: Review CONST - GA4 Measurement ID, then coordinate all reference rewrites if approved; no rename applied.

findings.title: GTM-NAME-001: vague folder name "misc"
findings.description: GTM-NAME-001 / NAME-FOLDER-001: existing name lacks the prescribed purpose and type context. Candidate: "GA4 - Event Measurement". Policy: manual_review_only.

evidence.observation: folderId=401; tag 101 and variable 301 have parentFolderId=401.
Proposed grouping purpose follows current members; intended folder ownership is unknown.

recommended_actions: Confirm grouping intent before considering GA4 - Event Measurement; no rename applied.

manual_review_items: F-001 / C-001: confirm no external dependency on exact tag name.
F-002: verify scope of PAGEVIEW trigger 201 before an All Pages name is accepted.
F-003: do not rename variable 301 without coordinated rewriting of {{id}} references.
F-004: confirm folder grouping intent before renaming.
Confirm whether tag 101 should send lead_submit on a PAGEVIEW trigger; firing behavior is not changed by this patch.
